newsitem.title: USA: Western Resources teams with China Power.
newsitem.headline: Western Resources teams with China Power.

text.p: Western Resources Inc said Wednesday it would team with China Power International Holdings Inc to find ways to meet China's increasing need for power.

The partnership involves several development projects with generating capacities of more than 2,000 megawatts of low-cost power production. The projects are to be located in the central provinces of China.

The agreement may ultimately involve the investment of $500 million, the company said. It includes acquiring interest in seven power plants and the option to expand the capacity of existing plants in China.
China Power International is a subsidiary of the China Power Investment Corp, which is the Chinese government's principal power company within the Ministry of Electric Power.
